itens.titulo: KiwiSaver hardship withdrawals hit record levels, but some could be avoided
itens.resumo: More than 52,000 members made hardship withdrawals in the year to June, but researchers say other options are being overlooked.

itens.resumo_pt: Mais de 52.000 membros fizeram retiradas difíceis no ano até junho, mas pesquisadores dizem que outras opções estão sendo negligenciadas.

itens.titulo: Dolly Parton's last song is out today
itens.resumo: Torn, U2's new duet featuring Dolly Parton, is the country music legend's swan song.

itens.titulo: NZ to attend APEC and East Asia Summit
itens.resumo: New Zealand will be represented by Prime Minister Christopher Luxon and Trade and Investment Minister Todd McClay at the APEC Leaders’ Meeting in China and Foreign Minister Winston Peters at the East Asia Summit in Philippines. These high-level meetings bring together leaders and ministers from across the Indo Pacific, and issues important to New Zealand’s security and prosperity will be...
itens.titulo_pt: NZ participará na Cimeira APEC e na Ásia Oriental
itens.resumo_pt: A Nova Zelândia será representada pelo Primeiro-Ministro Christopher Luxon e pelo Ministro do Comércio e Investimento, Todd McClay, na reunião dos líderes da APEC na China e pelo Ministro das Relações Exteriores, Winston Peters, na Cimeira da Ásia Oriental, nas Filipinas.

itens.titulo: Voters in areas with large Pacific populations clear on who should lead country
itens.resumo: While the general election result might be too close to call, Labour has again drawn strong support from communities with a large Pacific voter base.

itens.titulo: British Airways plane suffers tail strike as it attempts landing at London's Heathrow Airport

itens.resumo_pt: O avião, que voou de Amsterdã para Londres, tinha 200 passageiros a bordo.

itens.titulo: Fire and Emergency considers how to cover for striking fire crews
itens.resumo: Fire and Emergency is looking at how the Defence Force could help but has made no formal request two weeks' out from an unprecedented 10-hour Friday afternoon strike by most paid firefighters.

itens.titulo: 'Nail in the coffin': Wellington's Penthouse Cinema could face closure if council rates change

itens.resumo_pt: E outro dono de um negócio de hospitalidade está alarmado em pagar mais $100.000 também poderia forçá - lo a fechar.

itens.titulo: The Grand Theft Auto 'Kiwi hack' the world is talking about
itens.resumo: Forget booking a flight to New Zealand, GTA 6 fans from overseas reckon changing their Xbox region could be enough to start playing hours early.

itens.titulo: All Whites outclass India in series opener

itens.titulo: COP31: Climate action must continue even if 'US is not here', Pacific leaders say
itens.resumo: The United States government has no official presence at the climate talks in Türkiye, marking the second consecutive year the Trump administration has skipped the annual summit.

itens.titulo: Witness to Myers Park playground attack on child sought by police

itens.titulo: Kāpiti Coast Airport asks Kāpiti Aero Club to relinquish its lease by end of month
itens.resumo: Kāpiti Aero Club says it is taking legal advice after a request from Kāpiti Coast Airport Holdings Ltd that it surrender its lease ahead of a possible announcement of the airport's closure.

itens.titulo: Medsafe approves first medicine using the ‘Rule of Two’ pathway
itens.resumo: Paliperidone is the first medicine to be approved in New Zealand via the expedited ‘Rule of Two’ pathway, says Associate Health Minister David Seymour. “The ‘Rule of Two’ medicines approval pathway was introduced last year. It allows medicines to be approved within 30 days if the product has approval from two recognised overseas jurisdictions,” Mr Seymour says. The policy is starting with...
itens.titulo_pt: Medsafe aprova o primeiro medicamento utilizando a via “Regra de Dois”

Permite que os medicamentos sejam aprovados no prazo de 30 dias se o produto tiver aprovação de duas jurisdições estrangeiras reconhecidas”, diz o Sr. Seymour.
